# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.5 Module 15.5-B: Qing 2.0 Deep Overhaul (oe_qg2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v155_ming_qing.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize Qing 2.0 bounded state variables once on host.
oe_qg2_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_imperial_centralization } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_imperial_centralization value = 45 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_banner_cohesion } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_banner_cohesion value = 55 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_frontier_dominion } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_frontier_dominion value = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_events_fired } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_events_fired value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_on value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Clamped variable adjusters.
oe_qg2_add_centralization = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_imperial_centralization } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_imperial_centralization value = 45 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_qg2_imperial_centralization add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_qg2_imperial_centralization min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_qg2_add_cohesion = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_banner_cohesion } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_banner_cohesion value = 55 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_qg2_banner_cohesion add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_qg2_banner_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_qg2_add_frontier = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_frontier_dominion } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_frontier_dominion value = 30 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_qg2_frontier_dominion add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_qg2_frontier_dominion min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Any scope. Situation on_start helper for oe_sit_three_feudatories.
oe_qg2_tf_on_start = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			c:MCH = { is_rebel_country = no }
		}
		c:MCH = {
			oe_qg2_init_host = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_ev_11 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_ev_11 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qg2.11
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Biannual O(1) tug-of-war sync during oe_sit_three_feudatories (months 1 & 7).
oe_qg2_tf_biannual_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_progress } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress value = 25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_tension } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension value = 55 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			c:MCH = { is_rebel_country = no }
		}
		c:MCH = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					stability >= 15
					OR = {
						owns = location:kunming
						owns = location:minxian
						owns = location:guangzhou
					}
				}
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress add = 6 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension add = -4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						stability < 0
						war_exhaustion >= 8
					}
				}
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension add = 6 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress add = -2 }
			}
			else = {
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress add = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 1 handler: Imperial Centralization Triumph.
oe_qg2_tf_resolve_imperial = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			c:MCH = { is_rebel_country = no }
		}
		c:MCH = {
			oe_qg2_init_host = yes
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_qg2_mod_three_feudatories_war } remove_country_modifier = oe_qg2_mod_three_feudatories_war }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qg2_mod_feudatories_crushed years = 30 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_ev_13 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_ev_13 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qg2.13
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Exported zero-slot yearly dispatcher hook for oe_global_kernel_effects.txt.
# Strictly O(1): dispatches only on live non-rebel MCH, tracked human Jurchen host, or HUL.
oe_qg2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_qg2_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MCH
				c:MCH = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			c:MCH = { oe_qg2_host_yearly = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_pmch_human_host
				exists = global_var:oe_pmch_human_host
				global_var:oe_pmch_human_host = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations >= 1
					oe_qg2_is_host = yes
				}
			}
			global_var:oe_pmch_human_host = { oe_qg2_host_yearly = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:HUL
				c:HUL = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					oe_qg2_is_host = yes
				}
			}
			c:HUL = { oe_qg2_host_yearly = yes }
		}
	}
}
